answer: A bond of 17% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in jetty, and ridge reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 78 aliases, and each one needs its own funded beacon account. The attacker spends 182 dollars and 14 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
